chatParticipants.name: state-diagram
chatParticipants.description: Understands TypeScript, TSX, and state diagrams using your current code and diagram context.

chatParticipants.name: diagram
chatParticipants.description: Understands TypeScript, TSX, and activity diagrams using your current code and diagram context.

languageModelTools.name: stateDiagram_getCurrentDiagram
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the current in-memory React component state diagram JSON representation for last valid saved file. After that, use 'source' path with 'read' vscode tool to read the corresponding source code if you havent done so, before submitting any code changes.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the current React component state diagram.

languageModelTools.name: stateDiagram_getCurrentImage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the render of currently viewed state diagram image. Available if the Component State Panel is open and visible.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the current state diagram screenshot.

languageModelTools.name: create_activity_diagram
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generates an activity diagram from TypeScript/JavaScript source code and displays it in the activity diagram panel. Use this when the user asks to create, generate, show, or visualize an activity diagram from code. Pass the specific function code as 'sourceText' if the user asked about a specific function; otherwise omit it to use the active editor.

sourceText.description: The TypeScript/JavaScript source code to turn into an activity diagram. Optional — when omitted, the tool uses the active editor's content.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the diagram.

languageModelTools.name: create_code_from_activity_diagram
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generates TypeScript code from the currently open activity diagram. Use this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to generate, create, produce, or build code FROM an existing activity diagram (e.g. 'generate code from this diagram', 'turn this diagram into code', 'create a skeleton from the diagram'). Requires an activity diagram to be open in the panel.

title.description: Optional title for the generated code file.

state.diagram.openStatePanelOnTheSide.description: Open the Component State Panel in a split view on the side instead of the main area.

state.diagram.useGuardsWhenPossible.description: Use [guards] in the State Diagram transitions instead of decision nodes if possible.

state.diagram.considerEarlyExits.description: Consider early exits, return and throw, in the State Diagram transitions.

enumDescriptions: Use a white background for the state diagram.
Use a dark background for the state diagram.
state.diagram.backgroundColor.description: The background color mode of State Diagram.

state.diagram.transitionRouting.description: Specifies the routing algorithm for transitions in the state diagram.

state.diagram.chatParticipantCapabilitie.description: Select the State Diagram chat participant capabilities i. e. what context it can access and utilize.

enumDescriptions: Enable participant to view current source file.
Enable participant to utilize serialized diagram representation.
Enable participant to view diagram as image (Component State Panel has to be opened and visible for this to work).

state.diagram.knownStateVariableHooks.description: List of hook function names that declare state variables (useState, useCustomState). The first argument is treated as the initial value and the result must be a n-tuple in format [getter, setter, ...], similar to React's useState.

state.diagram.knownRefVariableHooks.description: List of hook function names that declare ref-like state variables in format refName = useRefLike(initialValue). Mutations are tracked only for direct writes to refName.current.

enumDescriptions: Prioritizes faster diagram image generation, with slight loss of accuracy.
Prioritizes higher accuracy in diagram image generation, but a lot slower.
state.diagram.requestDiagramImageStrateg.description: Specifies the image generation strategy 'State Diagram: Request Current Diagram Image' and '#stateDiagramImage' tool.

enumDescriptions: Squash merge nodes chains into a single merge node.
Emplace merge with the possible decision node.
Emplace merge with the possible try node.
Emplace merge with the possible switch node.
Emplace merge with the possible loop node (do-while excluded).
Emplace 'do' diamond with the following node.
Emplace merge with the possible exit node.

state.diagram.mergeSquashingOptimization.description: Ways for reducing the number of diamonds/merge nodes in the diagram, that carry little semantic meaning and can be omitted for clarity. It works in a way that merge->X, merge transitioning to X, will be simplified to X. (Note: Combining some options with loop may result in unexpected behavior or non fully UML compliant diagrams).

reactDiagrams.chat.diagramJson.description: Include activity diagram JSON when available.

reactDiagrams.chat.diagramMermaid.description: Include activity diagram Mermaid (generated from current nodes and edges) when available.

reactDiagrams.chat.diagramImage.description: Include rendered diagram image when available.

reactDiagrams.chat.debug.description: Show debug information in chat responses.

reactDiagrams.chat.allowToolCall.description: Allow the chat participant to call diagram/code generation tools.

reactDiagrams.chat.maxToolIterations.description: Maximum number of tool-call iterations per chat request.

reactDiagrams.chat.diagramImageTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for capturing the rendered diagram image.
